sloka: एष जेष्यति काकुत्स्थौ सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् ।वानरांश्चापरान् घोरान् हनिष्यति परन्तपः ।। ६.५५.४ ।।।।
transliteration: eṣa jeṣyati kākutsthau sugrīvaṁ ca mahābalam ।vānarāṁścāparān ghorān haniṣyati parantapaḥ ।। 6.55.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "Scorcher of enemies, this Akampana will win Sugriva of terrific might, Rama and Lakshmana, dreadful Vanaras, and put an end to enemies."
